$comment: Allowlist for scripts/db/content-sync.mjs. ONLY training content (curriculum, courses, enablers, use cases, quizzes) is ever synchronised between public_preview and public. Never user data: no profiles, organizations, submissions, progress, certificates, evaluations, notifications, hai_embeddings. The order follows the foreign keys (parents first). key = columns that identify a row across both schemas (stable keys); until the stable code columns exist, the keys marked status=provisional are natural keys. A foreign key column listed in remap is translated through the key of the parent table (the ids differ between the schemas). lookups = tables that are only READ to translate ids (matched by email or slug), their rows are never copied. update: always | newer | never (default newer = only if updated_at in the source is newer). optional=true: the table may be missing in one schema (created by a migration of another branch), it is then skipped with a note.

tables.name: training_catalogs
tables.note: Created by the training catalog migration of another branch (202610200001_training_catalog_curriculum.sql); not in schema.ts on master yet.

tables.name: courses
tables.note: No stable code column yet; replace the key by [code] once it exists.

tables.name: content_documents
tables.note: Metadata rows only (no file bytes, storage objects are shared). is_indexed_by_hai is not copied, hai_embeddings is never synchronised. Files uploaded from Preview live under the storage prefix preview/ and keep that path.

tables.name: lernfelder
tables.note: schema.ts defines pgTable('lernfelder') twice (lernfelder with code, lernfelderSchema with label). The first definition (code) is assumed.

tables.name: training_components
tables.note: The training catalog migration changes the unique constraint to (training_catalog_id, code); then set the key to [training_catalog_id, code].
